decision_scope: service diagnostic only; no scientific evidence, hypothesis, plan, scoring seed, candidate, benchmark, schema or scoring

prior_art_gates.SRC-0003: ACT establishes learned variable recurrent computation but not superiority over a transition-internal certificate
prior_art_gates.SRC-0172: PonderNet establishes learned compute-quality halting and therefore requires an explicit learned-versus-certificate contrast
prior_art_gates.SRC-0173: DEQ establishes fixed-point/root-finding computation, making residual or convergence stopping a mandatory control

prohibited_shortcuts: any masked-infilling test-role file or target, WT test files 8-9 or any three-family test target
file paths, semantic names, target bytes at decision time or post-diagnostic threshold selection
treating the evaluator's fixed confidence scheduler as a candidate-learned halt policy

masked_validation_diagnostic.candidate: iterative_masked_learner with its frozen train-only transition estimator
masked_validation_diagnostic.scheduler: the frozen evaluator rule: select highest maximum-probability positions and reveal ceil(remaining/(rounds-round_index)) predictions
masked_validation_diagnostic.observations: for each still-masked position at rounds 1 and 2, compare its current distribution with the previous round and the next-round distribution after other positions are filled
masked_validation_diagnostic.classical_certificate: total-variation distance between the current and previous 256-way distributions
masked_validation_diagnostic.future_benefit_label: one iff next-round true-byte log loss improves by at least 0.25 bits; target is used only offline after both public distributions are frozen
masked_validation_diagnostic.auc: pairwise Mann-Whitney probability that a positive signal exceeds a negative signal, with half credit for ties

contract_gates.masked_reason: the evaluator fixes the number of rounds, reveal quota and completion; a candidate only returns per-position distributions
contract_gates.wt_reason: the public 16/32/96 horizon specifies output length and no frozen target-free variable independently certifies how many internal iterations are required
contract_gates.three_family_reason: the active contract has reasoning_depths=[1] and fixed native rollouts

overall_pass_rule: every masked span passes all numerical gates and at least one frozen contract gives the candidate an auditable halt action at three difficulty levels independent of public output length; otherwise keep HYP-0004 dormant and create no hypothesis

outcomes.pass: a later wake may create one low-confidence hypothesis before implementation or scoring
outcomes.fail: record no_adaptive_halt_certificate_gap_contract and create no hypothesis, candidate, plan, benchmark or schema
